Iqtibas ko angrezi mein tarjuma karna
10.explanation: Fahm-o-Idraak ibarat ke asbaal mafhoom aur us se mutalliq nataij ko samajhne ki salahiyat parkhta hai.

10.question: Qawaid-e-insha mein 'Talkhees-Nigari' (تلخیص نگاری / Summary Writing) se kya murad hai?
options: Ibarat mein se saare mushkil alfaz nikaal dena
Asal ibarat ko teen guna lamba kar dena
Kisi taveel ibarat ke ahem nukat ko aasan alfaaz mein asal ibarat ke taqreeban ek-tihai (1/3) hisse mein sametna
Sirf pehli aur aakhri line likhna
10.explanation: Talkhees asal ibarat ke lubb-e-lubaab ko 1/3 alfaz mein apne alfaaz ke sath mukhtasar karne ka fann hai.

10.question: Talkhees-nigari karte waqt kin cheezon ko hazf (delete/exclude) kar dena chahiye?
options: Ghair-zaroori misalein, tashbeehaat, ash'aar, aur takraar wale jumle
10.explanation: Talkhees mein faqat asal mafhoom bachta hai; misalon, mubalghon aur shairana wazahat ko nikaal diya jata hai.

10.question: Kya talkhees-nigari mein talib-ilm ko apni zaati raye ya tabsera shamil karne ki ijazat hoti hai?
options: Zaati kahani shamil karna zaroori hai
Hargiz nahi, talkhees mein sirf musannif ke diye gaye khayalaat ka khulasa hona chahiye
Haan, aadha hissa apni zaati raye ka hona chahiye
Sirf musannif ki mukhalifat likhni chahiye
10.explanation: Talkhees amanat-dari ke sath faqat matn ke asal khayalaat ki paabandi karti hai, zaati raye manah hai.

10.question: Talkhees shuda ibarat ke liye 'Munasib Unwan' (Suitable Title) kaisa hona chahiye?
options: Jame, mukhtasar (2 ta 4 alfaaz), aur ibarat ke markazi khayal ki numaindagi karne wala
Pachaas lafzon ka ek lamba jumla
10.explanation: Unwan ibarat ke markazi nukte ka aainah-dar aur pur-kashish hona chahiye.

10.question: Kisi iqtibas ki 'Siyāq-o-Sabāq' (سیاق و سباق) ke hawalay se tashreeh karte waqt 'Siyāq' se kya murad hoti hai?
options: Iqtibas ke foran baad aane wale waqiyat aur mazmoon ka talluq
Iqtibas se pehle aane wale halat
10.explanation: Sabaq (pehle ke halat) aur Siyaq (baad ke halat) iqtibas ke darmiyani rabt ko kehte hain.

10.question: 'Sabāq' se kya murad hoti hai?
options: Iqtibas se pehle guzar chuka pas-e-manzar aur waqiyat
Iqtibas ke baad aane wala hissa
10.explanation: Sabaq se murad pehle guzra hua mazmoon hai jo iqtibas ki bunyad bana.

10.question: Iqtibas ki tashreeh mein 'Hawala-e-Matn' mein kon si do buniyadi cheezein likhi jati hain?

Sabaq ka unwaan aur Musannif ka naam (سبق کا عنوان اور مصنف کا نام)
10.explanation: Hawala-e-matn mein sabaq aur musannif ka naam darj karna laazmi hota hai.

10.question: Musannif ka 'Lehja' (Tone) pehchanna kyun zaroori hai?
options: Kyunke lehja dekh kar imtehan ka waqt badalta hai
Kyunke lehje se musannif ke jazbaat (tanz, gham, sanjeedagi, ya mazaah) aur maqsad ka pata chalta hai
Kyunke lehja sirf poetry mein hota hai
Ta-ke musannif ki aawaz record ki ja sake
10.explanation: Lehja tehreer ki andaruni rooh ko samajhne mein madad deta hai.

10.question: Agar kisi tehreer mein qaum ki kamzoriyon ka mazahiyya magar dard-mand andaz mein pardah chaak kiya jaye to lehja kya hoga?
10.explanation: Islahana tanz ka maqsad dil dukhana nahi balke buraai ki nishan-dahi kar ke islah karna hota hai.

10.question: Ibarat ke 'Markazi Khayal' (Central Theme) se kya murad hai?
options: Ibarat mein aane wale musafiron ki ta'dad
Woh buniyadi soch, falsafa ya sabaq jis ke ird-gird poori tehreer ghoomti hai
10.explanation: Markazi khayal tehreer ka roohani nukta aur asal paigham hota hai.

10.question: Unseen passage padhte waqt mushkil alfaaz ke maani samajhne ka behtareen tareeqa kya hai?
options: Imtehan hall mein doosron se poochna
Jumle ke siyaq-o-sabaq aur aage peechhe ke alfaz ki roshni mein andaza lagana (Contextual Clues)
Lafz ko chhod kar aage nikal jana
10.explanation: Siyaq-o-sabaq ke hawale se lafz ka maani aam taur par khud wazeh ho jata hai.

10.question: Ibarat mein jab dalail aur mantaqi saboot de kar qari ko qael kiya jaye to tehreer ka tarz kya kehlata hai?
10.explanation: Istadlaali tarz aqal aur dalail ki roshni mein baat manwane ka andaz hai.

10.question: Ibarat mein jab jazbaat, manzar aur ehsasat ko ubhara jaye to woh tarz kya kehlata hai?
10.explanation: Tassurati tarz jazbaat aur ehsasat par asar daalne ke liye apnaya jata hai.

10.question: Kisi tehreer ka 'Maqsad-e-Tehreer' (Author's Purpose) kya ho sakta hai?
options: Aagahi dena, Islah karna, Qael karna, ya Mahzooz karna (معلومات، اصلاح، قائل کرنا، یا محظوظ کرنا)
10.explanation: Har sanjeedah musannif kisi wazeh tehzeebi, fikri ya adabi maqsad ke tehat likhta hai.

10.question: Iqtibas ki tashreeh karte waqt talib-ilm ko kin baton ka khayal rakhna chahiye?
options: Ibarat ke mafhoom ko aasan alfaaz mein khoal kar bayan karna aur musannif ke fikr ko wazeh karna
10.explanation: Tashreeh ka matlab wazahat aur khol kar bayan karna hai.

10.question: Talkhees-nigari mein aam taur par kin alfaaz ke istemal se gurez karna chahiye?
options: Musannif ke asal jumlon ko hu-ba-hu naqal karne se (apne alfaz mein likhna chahiye)
10.explanation: Talkhees mein naqal ke bajaye zaati zaban mein khulasa banana asbaal fann hai.

10.question: Agar asal ibarat 150 alfaaz par mushtamil ho to us ki miyari talkhees kitne alfaaz ki honi chahiye?
10.explanation: 1/3 hissa 150 ka taqreeban 50 alfaaz banta hai.

10.question: Ibarat mein 'Tashbeeh' ya 'Ista'ara' ka istemal musannif kyun karta hai?
options: Apni tehreer ko pur-asar, khoobsurat aur wazeh banane ke liye
Qawaid ki ghalti karne ke liye
10.explanation: Adabi sanaaye tehreer mein husn aur taseer paida karte hain.

10.question: Unseen comprehension solve karte waqt sab se pehla amal kya hona chahiye?
options: Ibarat ko kam az kam do baar tawajjoh aur ghour se padhna
Sawal padhe baghair tick mark lagana
Pehle hi minute mein jawabat likhna shuru kar dena
10.explanation: Ghour se do dafa mutala karne se poori ibarat ka taana baana zehen mein baith jata hai.

10.question: Ibarat mein 'Nateeja-Khez' (نتیجہ خیز) lafz ka matlab kya hota hai (case 21)?
